loop: CANDIDATE -> DIAGNOSE WEAKNESS -> IDENTIFY LIMITING FEATURE -> GENERATE CONTROLLED MUTATION -> RE-EVALUATE EVIDENCE/MECHANISM/PRIOR ART -> RE-SCORE -> KEEP OR KILL -> REPEAT

SPAN_DERIVATION_MIN.justification: the engine's own span-derivation rule (candidate_diversity.span_derivation_check): ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED. A MECHANISM_STRENGTHENING mutation must CLEAR this floor — the same rule that gates the grid, not a new one.

EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_MIN.justification: I1's underived flag fires below 0.20; an EVIDENCE_DERIVED_CONSTRAINT mutation must clear the same floor on evidence_support.

DOMAIN_OVERLAP_MIN.justification: REPLAY_CACHE re-adjudication is valid only while the mutated candidate stays in the domain the cached art was found FOR. Guard: >= 1 NON-generic technical term shared between the child's mechanism+intervention and the cached family corpus. ZERO overlap means the mutation abandoned the domain (measured attack: re-adjudicating a cement-curing intervention against battery art fabricates surviving differentiators — false novelty from stale art). The overlap count is RECORDED on every cache adjudication so thin-domain links are auditable. NOTE: entity-term retention vs the problem CANNOT catch this class — entity terms are problem-derived and unchanged by mutations (measured while writing the guard's tests); it is recorded for audit only.

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO minimum loop is DIAGNOSE -> IMPROVE -> RE-EVALUATE -> IMPROVE AGAIN; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

fields.MECHANISM: Engineering benchtop equipment such as Coriolis flow meters, pressure transducers, and volumetric measurement devices are combined with small, targeted systematic evaluations querying operators, equipment, and the physics and fluid dynamics that make a seemingly simple task of injecting fluid into a patient a complex and non-linear endeavor
fields.INTERVENTION: Integrate a miniaturized pressure transducer and flow monitoring system within the pump head to continuously monitor and adjust the occlusion force distribution across all tube lines, dynamically redistributing pressure to prevent localized fatigue
fields.EXPECTED_EFFECT: More even distribution of occlusion forces across all tube lines, eliminating single-point fatigue and extending tubing service life beyond 500 hours while maintaining 0.5 mL/min flow with better than 2% dosing accuracy
fields.MECHANISM_SOURCE_SPAN: Engineering benchtop equipment such as Coriolis flow meters, pressure transducers, and volumetric measurement devices are combined with small, targeted systematic evaluations querying operators, equipment, and the physics and fluid dynamics that make a seemingly simple task of injecting fluid into a patient a complex and non-linear endeavor
fields.EXPERIMENT: Compare the modified peristaltic pump head with integrated pressure monitoring against a standard pump head without pressure monitoring to measure tubing service life and dosing accuracy over 500 hours of operation
fields.EXPERIMENT_BASELINE: standard pump head without pressure monitoring
fields.CONSTRAINT_DERIVED: The mechanism must directly reference the use of engineering benchtop equipment including Coriolis flow meters, pressure transducers, and volumetric measurement devices combined with systematic evaluations of operators, equipment, and fluid dynamics
fields.MUTATION_REASON: Repairs the underived mechanism vocabulary by anchoring it directly to the evidence text, ensuring technical terms match exactly
